Note:- It must be ensured that Hardware vendors for Server Class Systems provide
device drivers for all components for working under DOS/Unix Ware/ Windows 2000/
NT Server/ SCO Open Server operating systems. Driver support for components
should be particularly ensured for SCSI controller, I/O controller and Ethernet
Card for SCO Open Server (5.0.X), SCO Unixware (7.X), Linux, Windows
2000/2003 Server etc. Recent experience has shown that ultra SCSI-3 Controllers do not
have driver support in certain version of SCO Unixware. In such circumstances
SCO/Caldera Open Server (V 5.0.X) Operating System with compatible FoxBase+ may
be considered which has driver support for SCSI-3 controllers. In any case, the terms and
conditions of purchase must include a clause making it obligatory for the vendor to load
the Operating System along with compatible FoxBase+ and ensure that the EPFO
applications run smoothly.
